ko.executive_summary: iPronics secured $125M Series B funding for optical switching solutions targeting AI data centers. Coherent launched PhotonLink, an AI datacenter optics product, signaling intensified competition in high-speed optical interconnect systems.
key_facts: iPronics focuses on optical switching for AI data centers
Coherent launched PhotonLink AI datacenter optics product

implications.text: Strong venture funding and major OEM product launches indicate accelerating market demand for optical switching in AI/hyperscale infrastructure.
Both startup and incumbent players (Coherent) are actively developing datacenter optics, intensifying the competitive landscape for optical switching solutions.
Optical switching and AI datacenter optics are emerging as critical subsystems for next-generation data center architectures.

ko.counterpoint: Limited details provided on PhotonLink specifications, market timing, or competitive differentiation against iPronics and other optical switching players.
